tasks.prompt: For a Unix Bash session with GNU coreutils, capture text typed on standard input into interview-notes.txt until end of input. Use cat and give the command.
For a Unix Bash session with GNU coreutils, copy the file reached by the symlink current-policy into issued/, following the link instead of copying the link itself. Give the command.

For a Unix Bash session, encrypt interview-notes.txt with a passphrase before putting the encrypted file in issued/. Give a command that performs the encryption.

For a Unix Bash session with GNU coreutils, resume an interrupted copy of a large file at the last transferred byte instead of copying it again from the beginning. Source is disk-image.bin and destination is issued/disk-image.bin. Give the command.
For a Unix Bash session with GNU find, list entries in ./staging whose size is greater than 700 kilobytes but less than 8 megabytes, searching no deeper than one level. Give the command.
For a Unix Bash session with GNU grep, find lines in arrivals.log matching either arrival or departure regardless of letter case, using an extended regular expression. Give the command.
For a Unix Bash session, search arrivals.log.gz directly for customs without first saving a decompressed file. Give the command.
For a Unix Bash session with GNU grep, match the phrase customs approved even when customs and approved occur on consecutive lines in arrivals.log. Give the command.
For a Unix Bash session with GNU find, locate files beneath ./staging owned by the account archivist. Give the command.
For a Unix Bash session with sed, run the editing program in normalize.sed on the standard output of build-inventory and display the transformed output. Give the pipeline.
For a Unix Bash session with sed, display only the first line emitted by build-inventory. Give the pipeline.

For a Unix Bash session with GNU sort, order colon-separated records in registry.txt by the third field numerically, breaking ties using the fourth field as numbers that may contain exponents. Give the command.
For a Unix Bash session with GNU sort, sort semicolon-separated rows in registry.txt by the second field while keeping rows with equal keys in their original relative order. Give the command.
For a Unix Bash session with sed, delete every line between BEGIN_PRIVATE and END_PRIVATE in the output of build-inventory, including both marker lines. Give the pipeline.
